summary: The helper now canonicalizes the upgraded origin, and the new regression tests cover both return-to validation and an origin-guarded mutation through a proxied runtime URL containing port 443. No actionable defects were found.

evidence: `src/request_origin.ts` now returns `new URL(scheme://host).origin`, canonicalizing the scheme-upgraded origin so default ports are removed.
`src/handler_test.ts` lines 944-951 send `http://proxy.example.com:443/login` with `x-forwarded-proto: https` and assert the return-to remains `/device` instead of falling back to `/`.
`src/handler_test.ts` lines 1259-1271 exercise a CSRF-guarded session logout through the same proxied port-443 URL with the canonical origin header and assert a 204 response.
